lines.text: Jehu tells the people to summon all of Baal's servants for a great sacrifice, and whoever is missing will not live.
All Baal's servants fill the temple of Baal, and Jehu has the keeper of the wardrobe bring out lamps for them.
Jehu stations fifty men outside, and after the burnt offering he orders the guards and officers to kill them.
Jehu's men burn the sacred pillar and make the temple of Baal a latrine, but Jehu keeps the sins of Jeroboam.
Jehu is buried in Samaria after reigning twenty-eight years, and his son Jehoahaz reigns in his place.
